## Heads up: this PR will be closed

TextLayr is a single-author project and doesn't accept unsolicited pull
requests. A bot closes this automatically, with no judgement about the work
itself.

Please use one of these instead:

- **Bug?** [Open a bug report](https://github.com/PaulBuitenhuis/TextLayr/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Idea or question?** [Discussions](https://github.com/PaulBuitenhuis/TextLayr/discussions).
- **Security problem?** [Private advisory](https://github.com/PaulBuitenhuis/TextLayr/security/advisories/new) — never a public PR.
- **A patch you want to exist?** Fork the repo. MIT allows it; rename the fork,
  replace the icon, and don't present it as the official TextLayr.

Full policy: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/PaulBuitenhuis/TextLayr/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contribution-policy).
